nonblockingFindings.finding: The schema validates record shape, but does not enforce unique stage IDs, dependency resolution or acyclicity. The supplied graph satisfies these properties by inspection. Describe schema validation separately from the semantic validation required of the future dispatcher.

nonblockingFindings.location: REPORT-RECONCILIATION: Stage admission and route disposition
nonblockingFindings.finding: Clarify that continued P2 generation while the finalizer route is blocked requires an already completed f0a or an explicitly revised admission route. The current graph requires f0a before f1-fixtures, so an F0 no-go does not itself permit that continuation. This does not block the main plan: the authoritative dependencies stop dispatch safely.

acceptedScope.dependencies: All 16 stage IDs are unique; all 29 requires references resolve; the stage graph and package acceptance graph are acyclic. Preparation stages do not require their own completion. Package acceptance dependencies are explicitly separated from preparation eligibility.
acceptedScope.profiles: MC01-ATOMIC gates initial I2/F2 and atomic F3. Full RP01 gates later semantic extensions, with changed proof and ledger domains requiring requalification.
acceptedScope.F1: P1 and P3 must execute in the selected outer ledger circuit stack. P1-IVC includes full challenge, preparation and carried-accumulator agreement using independently generated non-loan P2 evidence. No MC03 loan proof is a fixture prerequisite.
acceptedScope.finalizerControls: The same frozen constrained finalizer must accept an independently checked nontrivial valid fixture and reject direct-assignment mutations, with independent reference results. Missing or failed controls block promotion.
acceptedScope.F0NoGo: MC04 owns bounded route inspection, with MC03 export support. A shared 30-minute decision ceiling, persistent accounting, reviewed allocation and explicit interface-blocked stop disposition prevent open-ended boundary spending or product substitution.
acceptedScope.product: The plan preserves a Midnight-centric bounded Turing-incomplete DSL, mandatory PCD, complete ACTUS/DeFi obligations, actual Preview financial acceptance and isolated private branching handoff.
acceptedScope.reviewAndPublication: Future gates require exact claude-fable-5-1 at medium effort and fresh gpt-6-astra at high effort. Publication remains local commits only.

limits: This approval establishes neither execution admission, feasibility, implementation correctness nor package or release acceptance.
Missing generated proofs, codecs, finalizer implementations and dispatcher integration are explicitly planned work, not independently blocking plan defects.
Reference verification covers supplied stage/package identifiers; repository-wide paths, anchors, hashes and command existence were not independently checked.
Outside report claims, Preview provenance and fixture-source assertions were not independently verified. The fixture note was treated solely as supplied source evidence.
No builds, proofs, tests, network actions, edits, commits or external reviewer calls were performed. No other reviewer verdict was assumed.
